## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

The *Otaraṇahāravibhaṅga* ("Conveying Ways of Entry: Analysis", Ne 15) is a chapter of the *Nettippakaraṇa* (Netti). As an analytical exposition (*vibhaṅga*) of the *otaraṇa-hāra*—one of the interpretive devices (*hāra*) for conveying or guiding discourse into fundamental doctrinal frameworks—the section analyzes key doctrinal categories such as dependent origination, the aggregates (*khandha*), and sense bases [Stuart]. In section 15.49 (PTS 79–80), the text defines the meaning of aggregate (*khandhattha*) through the notions of collective combination (*samūhattha*), accumulation (*puñjattha*), and heap (*rāsattha*) [Stuart]. Daniel Stuart observes that this characteristic definitional formula is shared with the *Peṭakopadesa* (Pet 6.60) and an unpublished Gāndhārī commentary on the *Saṅgītisūtra*, indicating possible exegetical connections to Buddhist traditions of Greater Gandhāra [Stuart].
